searchText: Can someone confirm that the spadina genesis block root is 72bdcfa7ee71aa3f323f5cfcbab1f83394aef85afd88f37d2d47e29abbccfb03 ? Nimbus detected the same genesis - blockRoot=72bdcfa7, stateRoot=cee4c831 <@!553610810652622860> can confirm, same genesis block root for nimbus here But Teku is reporting a different one <https://spadina.beaconcha.in/block/0> State root 0xcee4c8312fa3b5570a24a21c948c10a5f892929eff02a308836c8f5c89971073 🎉 Fixing a little bug in Teku right now... new version soon! Teku 0.12.8 is now out (having fixed a minor validator activation issue), and includes the genesis state for Spadina so an ETH1 endpoint is no longer required when connecting to Spadina.
